status.description: `late` is never stored: a pending participant becomes late once the scheduled time passes.

registeredBy.description: Staff member who registered the current status. Never sent to guardians.

participants.description: By resident name. A guardian only gets the participants who are their residents.

detail.description: Free complement whose meaning depends on the type (which exercise, what gathering).

medicationId.description: Only for a `medication` activity: the prescription of its single participant.

residentIds.description: Residents of the caller clinic taking part.

rating.description: How it went for the resident, from 1 to 5.
How it went for the resident, from 1 to 5.

clinicId.description: Null before the resident is linked to a clinic and after a discharge.

roomId.description: A room of the caller clinic with a free bed.

maskedCpf.description: Only the check digits are visible (`•••.•••.•••-09`).

contactedClinicIds.description:
Clinics this guardian already contacted while looking for one. Only
returned to the guardian themself: a clinic must not learn which other
clinics the family is talking to.

cpf.description: With or without punctuation; validated by its check digits.

refreshToken.description: Omitted for the web app, which receives the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie.

cpf.description: With or without punctuation; validated by its check digits.

refreshToken.description: Sent by the mobile app; the web app relies on the httpOnly cookie instead.

readAt.description: When the logged-in user read it; null while unread.

activities.description: Services offered by the clinic, as free text (not the schedule).

cpf.description: With or without punctuation; validated by its check digits.

roomId.description: A room of the caller clinic with a free bed.

recordedBy.description: Staff member who recorded it. Never sent to guardians.

residentId.description: A resident of the caller clinic.

value.description: Reading with its unit, e.g. `130/85 mmHg`; for `other`, also what was measured.

recordedAt.description: When it was measured; defaults to now and can't be in the future.

endDate.description: Null while the treatment is continuous.

active.description: False once the treatment was ended (deactivated).

endDate.description: Leave it out for a continuous treatment.

senderId.description: StaffMember or Guardian id, depending on `senderRole`.

senderName.description: Name of the sender when the message was sent.

authorId.description: StaffMember or Guardian id, depending on `authorRole`.

authorName.description: Name of the author when the feedback was sent.

rating.description: Rating of the app, from 1 to 5.

active.description: A paused routine generates no activities.

residentIds.description: Required with `specificResidents`; residents of your clinic.

roomIds.description: Required with `specificRoom`; rooms of your clinic.

instructions.description: Becomes the `detail` of every generated activity.

capacity.description: Sum of the capacity of the rooms.

occupancyRate.description: `occupiedBeds / capacity`, from 0 to 1; null without rooms.

pendingLinkRequests.description: Same count as the link request queue.

types.description: Every type, also the ones with no activity, in the enum order.

rate.description: `taken / due`, from 0 to 1; null without doses due.
`taken / due`, from 0 to 1; null without doses due.

days.description: One point per day of the period.

total.description: Participations whose time already passed, except cancelled ones.

late.description: Still pending after the scheduled time.

completedRate.description: Each count over `total`, from 0 to 1; null when `total` is 0.

days.description:
End of each day, recorded since the snapshots started; today is the
occupancy now. Days before the first snapshot have no point.

total.description: Feedback the clinic received in the period.

average.description: Rounded to 2 places; null without feedback.

histogram.description: Ratings 1 to 5, also the ones nobody gave.

respondedAt.description: When the clinic approved or rejected it.

rejectionReason.description: Only when rejected; visible to the guardians.

residentId.description: A resident of the guardian, linked to a clinic.

notes.description: Destination, medication to take along, contact during the outing.

occupants.description: Residents in the room now, by name.

capacity.description: Can't go below the number of residents in the room.

maskedCpf.description: Only the check digits are visible (`•••.•••.•••-09`); null when not informed.

deactivatedAt.description: Set when the staff member was deactivated; they can no longer log in.
